brief.rates_bonds: Supplied October 28 observations are two calendar days old: 2-year Treasury 4.67%, 10-year 5.05%, 10-year real yield 2.67%, and high-yield spread 3.14 percentage points. The nominal curve is positively sloped by 38bp; these are not live yields. Supplied October 30 trades show IEF +0.40%, TLT +0.36% and HYG -0.15% versus prior closes, consistent with defensive positioning but insufficient to establish its cause. [Treasury yield series](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DGS10), [credit spread series](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/BAMLH0A0HYM2).
brief.fed_macro: The October 28 FOMC held its target at 3.75–4.00%; two dissenters preferred a 25bp increase. Inflation remained elevated. [Fed statement](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20261028a.htm). Today's 08:30 EDT ECI release reported civilian compensation +0.8% quarterly and +3.4% annually, versus +0.9% quarterly previously. [BLS release](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/eci.nr0.htm). Yesterday's September PCE release showed headline inflation +0.5% monthly/+3.6% annually and core +0.3%/+3.1%, while real spending increased less than 0.1%. Slower compensation growth is countered by persistent consumer inflation and weak real spending; consensus surprises are unknown. [BEA release](https://www.bea.gov/news/2026/personal-income-and-outlays-september-2026).
brief.earnings: Catalyst discovery: XOM's official calendar schedules today's earnings call for 09:30–approximately 10:30 EDT, overlapping the research cutoff. Presentation and formal remarks were scheduled for approximately 06:30 EDT; the exact earnings-release timestamp and filing contents were not checked. XOM's supplied trade is +1.79%, but its $176.38/$189.01 IEX quote is too wide to support a defensible entry. [XOM event page](https://investor.exxonmobil.com/news-events/ir-calendar/detail/20261030-3q-2026-earnings-call). Apple search coverage surfaced June-quarter results, which cannot verify an October earnings event. Other universe earnings dates and release times remain unverified.
brief.market_conditions: Supplied single-exchange trades versus prior closes: SPY -1.19%, QQQ -2.68%, IWM -0.75%, DIA -0.32%; XLK -3.87%, XLF -0.36%, XLE +1.32%, XLV +1.63%. This suggests technology-led selling with selective defensive/energy strength; exchange-wide advance/decline breadth and consolidated volume are unavailable. WMT +1.72% is an observation candidate, but its catalyst is unknown. October 29 daily indicators are one calendar day old. Fresh snapshots lack opening-range, VWAP and intraday support histories; running 'daily_close' fields are not completed-session closes. Several quotes are extremely wide, and COST's daily-indicator close differs from the snapshot's prior close.
brief.cross_market: Supplied trades show USO +0.87%, GLD -2.37% and UUP -0.09% versus prior closes. Oil strength supports the energy-relative-strength observation, while gold weakness contradicts a uniform flight to defensive assets. UUP's last trade is approximately six minutes old despite a newer quote. The VIX observation of 17.2 is dated October 29 and cannot describe today's volatility. No geopolitical cause was independently verified.
brief.narratives: Knowledge ID 2026-10-30-swing-reversal informed inspection of GOOGL, META and UNH; supplied five-session losses cannot substitute for the required exact three-session return. Positive swing holdout means conflict with slightly negative stressed development results and losing intraday reversal evidence. Knowledge ID 2026-10-30-swing-earnings informed XOM discovery, but today's first full reaction session is incomplete; the reviewed hypothesis requires timestamped releases and next-session observation. Neither hypothesis establishes an edge. Options remain SHADOW ONLY: 30 indicative contracts provide no verified executable prices, matched IV observations or defensible event-premium comparison. A correct stock direction can still lose through volatility repricing and spreads. Forward evidence contains zero completed observed sessions and no evaluable return means; no promotion or tuning is justified.

decisions.title: Let recorded observations originate prospective tests
decisions.why: Published mechanisms and fixed plan filters alone cannot discover or measure new ideas when no trade plan exists. Timestamped observations now feed independently reviewed, immutable declarative studies.
decisions.evidence: Local provenance and independent method checks; future sessions only; explicit comparators, missingness and costs. Existing fixed study preserved.

decisions.title: Recovery is separate from the trader

decisions.title: Research review does not certify an edge

decisions.title: Observe fixed signals without forcing orders
decisions.why: Waiting for model-generated price plans can starve research. Twelve preregistered cohorts can collect fresh paired quote observations across the liquid universe.
decisions.evidence: Pre-open signal freeze; first observed quotes; missing exits are not evaluable. No broker allocation or automatic promotion.

decisions.title: Keep historical units attached to the numbers
decisions.why: Five-session unit-opportunity returns were repeatedly mistaken for daily portfolio returns. Derived evidence now names the horizon and aggregation explicitly.
decisions.evidence: Frozen data/hash retained; historical screens never count toward forward promotion.

decisions.title: Bound role context and finish within tool budgets
decisions.why: A shared thread grew beyond 100,000 cached input tokens and quick checks hit tool limits. Separate role context, bounded rotation, compact packets and soft budget notices reduce avoidable failure paths.
decisions.evidence: Task usage/context-rotation records. Decision-quality and token savings still require matched forward evaluation.

trials.hypothesis: Prospective long-only descriptive rule on six specified stocks over 60 actual entry sessions. Features and first valid ask observation follow adaptive-observation-v1, including contemporaneous SPY relative ask change. Observe to the same-session close-minus-12-minute window. Compare the confirming and failing rules using all opportunities with false signals cash=0, 20bp/50bp costs and equal entry-session weights. The policies share the predefined opportunity universe, but active exposures differ; this is not a causal paired-treatment test.
trials.falsification: Across the first 60 future entry sessions, require at least 30 evaluable active closed signals per rule. Reject the descriptive prediction if the confirming rule has nonpositive all-opportunity mean after 50bp cost, or confirming minus failing all-opportunity mean is below 0.002 under either cost. Means average symbol opportunities including cash within entry date, then across dates. Missing opportunities stay reported; missing dates or insufficient signals are inconclusive.

protocol.entry: First valid ask from open+15m inclusive to open+30m exclusive; all predicates ANDed.
protocol.features: Returns and price_vs_sma20 use the previous actual session's completed daily close. gap_from_prior_close uses the entry-observation ask / prior close - 1; relative_gap_spy subtracts the same contemporaneous SPY ask change. These are not opening-auction gaps.
protocol.inputs: Same-ET-day private archived packet, at most two hours old, no future capture; prior daily data must match the preceding actual broker session. Unknown is not false.
protocol.exit: First valid bid in close-12m through close exclusive on actual holding session 1 or 5. Missing observations are not evaluable; no later price backfill.
protocol.costs: ask-to-bid gross minus assumed20bp base /50bp stressed round trip; spreads already reflected in ask/bid, no fill guarantee.
protocol.unit: Holding-horizon unit opportunity, cash=0 for observed false signals. Same-symbol always-long comparator, no portfolio allocation or broker P&L.
protocol.authority: Descriptive research only. No automatic promotion, orders, significance test or profitability certification.

protocol.signals: Prior completed Alpaca IEX daily bars only; provider daily closes are not guaranteed consolidated closing-auction prices. Six fixed rules. Raw reversal is not a classified non-fundamental liquidity shock.
protocol.entry: First observed valid ask from actual market open +5 through +30 minutes, never a reconstructed fill.
protocol.exit: First valid bid from actual close -12 minutes through the close on holding session 1 or 5; missing exits are not evaluable.
protocol.quote_validation: Bid/ask finite, positive, ordered; bid >= $5; quote age between -5 and 90 seconds; spread / midpoint <=0.5% and spread / ask <=0.5%.
protocol.cost_formula: gross=exit_bid/entry_ask-1; net=gross-0.002-(entry_ask-entry_bid)/entry_ask-(exit_ask-exit_bid)/exit_ask; stress=net-0.003. Ask/bid already includes spread; the extra spread terms are conservative additional assumed penalties, not measured fees.
protocol.reporting_window: Twenty broker-calendar entry sessions fixed before the first observation, followed by four possible swing maturation sessions. No optional extension to obtain a winner; descriptive results only.
protocol.denominator: Preregister every eligible rule/symbol/horizon opportunity. Missing prior-session data and non-overlap exclusions are reported separately. Missing entry or exit quotes are not evaluable, never zeros or fills. Net means condition on evaluable observations; show their count against all preregistered opportunities.
protocol.unit: Holding-horizon returns per unit opportunity, cash=0 for observed signal abstentions; average within entry date then across entry dates. Symbols and variants are correlated; entry dates are not proven independent observations.
protocol.comparison: Historical bar-open/close screens differ from this forward quote protocol. They are hypothesis-generation evidence only.
protocol.authority: No broker orders, allocated capital, automatic promotion, causal controls, annualized return or profitability claim.
